next.reason: 1985: '[ALL] ZERO, [ALL] ZEROS, [ALL] ZEROES Represents the numeric value 0, or one or more of the character 0 from the computer's character set' (§1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3). 2023 keeps the same words (§2023:8.3.3.6.2) and 'The zero format represents the numeric value 0, one or more of the boolean character 0, or one or more of the character 0 in the computer's runtime coded character set, depending on context' (§2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR4); the character value is national only 'in a context requiring national characters' (§2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR1). The boolean and national values arise only in boolean and national contexts, which no 1985 program contains; in every 1985 context ZERO means the same numeric or character value.
